name: Hatori Uta
source:
Uta is a 2nd year high school student. She is Yoichi's childhood friend, and often comes to visit the Kodou family.
She is an only child, and daughter of "HATORI", one of the world's leading manufacturers of electronics.

Roughly edited from a Google Translation of the following website: [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/未来ノスタルジア]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]
